verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page lists a built-in "AI-powered subject line generator". Its AI page says you can tell Composer your goal and it will "draft the content" and build marketing for your review, which covers AI drafting of subject lines and copy from a brief. The evidence is only short marketing claims, and it never shows AI refining existing copy inside the email editor. Missing for 10: explicit in-editor refine/rewrite of existing copy, detailed first-party docs on the copy-generation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
